nom: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner

avis.texte: I’ve been using this product for almost a month. There is no smell to the toner and it is a clear liquid with medium viscosity. I don’t like the consistency of this toner as it leaves a sticky residue. Bc it is so sticky I don’t apply multiple layers and make sure to apply it last. On the upside, my skin tone has brightened. I can’t speak for individual post-inflammatory marks just yet. I will update this review when I have completed 3 months of use.

avis.titre: Love this toner, makes my skin look and feel great
avis.texte: I've only just recently started taking skin care seriously and have only tried a handful of toners so far so I don't have a lot of experience with them. Of all the toners I have tried, this one has been my favorite so far. I love that this toner helps to strengthen the skin's barrier and that it helps to even out skin tone, reduce dark spots, improves skin texture, and keeps the skin soft and hydrated. These are all the things I'm concerned about most with my skin so having one product that can tackle them all, is great! I haven't been using this toner that long yet but I'm already noticing a difference how my skin looks and feels. I've been using it after washing my face in the morning and evening in combination with another toner, a heartleaf hyaluronic acid and witch hazel one. While I was having okay results just using my other toner, once I added this Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner it really elevated my skin. I haven't experienced any irritation with my skin at all. Instead my skin is left feeling soft, moisturized skin that's starting to look healthier and more even. One of my favorite things about this product though is the price. It's super affordable and very reasonable for a product like this especially considering how long it should last you. I would definitely recommend this toner and plan to make it a staple in my skin care routine.

avis.titre: Glowy toner without being too oily or shiny
avis.texte: This toner promises to moisturize, smooth skins texture and leave it with a glow. It is moisturizing and the first “glowy” toner I’ve tried that gives some glow without making my skin look shiny or oily. It does give it a somewhat tacky feel, but maybe that’s the “elasticity” it claims to be boosting. So far so good will have to see how well it works long term.

Really nice! Not too heavy despite being a milky toner. It sinks in well and leaves my skin with a glowy look. I think it has helped with texture slightly but hard to tell because I do use other exfoliants and retinol products.

This has some really great ingredients! It has Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate as the first ingredient (eve before water!), and has it listed as 86.24%. I really appreciate when a product uses the ingredient they're highlighting in their product in a high concentration rather than putting it at the end of the ingredients list. This stuff has historically worked well for my skin, giving it a nice glow and helping with my pores. There's also niacinamide, rice extract, vitamin e, and ceramide np, and that's not even everything! I LOVE that this doesn't have any added known irritants or fragrance either (the ingredients on other websites show this might have lavender oil, but my ingredients on the box say otherwise and I don't smell anything either, YAY). I really really wish this didn't include dimethicone though. While it's a fantastic ingredient in skincare and can give a smoothing effect, it's something I try to avoid, ESPECIALLY in my first steps/toners. Silicones can limit the absorption of successive products (which isn't great especially in toners since they're usually my first step after cleansing). With that being said, this is solidly formulated and has really lovely ingredients. It feels nice, absorbs nicely too (and you can layer it well!). I love milky toners, they're ever so slightly more viscous than watery toners but sink in just as quickly and this is no exception. This bottle is priced fantastically (around $13 at the time of this review) for how much you get too

This SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner is a nice milky toner that gives your skin a glow. It seems to make a difference in skin appearance - more smooth and glowy. Some of the ingredients may not be for everyone, especially those with sensitive or acne-prone skin - but a nice toner if suited to your skin type.
